items.title: Full bathroom renovations
items.description: Stripped back to bare walls and floor, then rebuilt: new pipework, waste and extraction, boarding, tanking, tiling, suite, lighting and decorating. We can move the bath, shower or WC for a better layout.

items.title: Shower rooms & wet rooms
items.description: Walk-in showers with frameless glass, low-profile trays or fully tanked wet-room floors laid to a fall, with built-in niches and concealed valves.

items.title: Accessible bathrooms
items.description: Level-access showers, slip-resistant flooring, grab rails, comfort-height WCs and wipe-clean wall panels, so the room works for everyone in the house.

items.title: Cloakrooms & under-stairs WCs
items.description: A WC and basin fitted into a small space, including new pipework, boxing in and panelling.

items.title: Tiling
items.description: Wall and floor tiling in porcelain, ceramic, natural stone and mosaic, including large-format slabs and patterned floors set out by hand.

items.title: Plumbing & heating
items.description: New radiators and heated towel rails, moving pipework and replacing leaking wastes and valves, done by an NVQ Level 2 qualified plumber.
